scenario.name: 06 - Delivery & Fulfillment: Episode Delivery + Feedback
scenario.description: Handles episode delivery workflow. When an episode is marked as 'Approved' in Airtable, sends delivery notification email to client with all deliverable links. Also handles onboarding reminder emails and onboarding completion.

modules.name: Router (Main)
modules.description: Three parallel workflows in this scenario

modules.name: Airtable - Search Records (Episodes)
modules.description: Find episodes with status 'Approved' that haven't been delivered yet

modules.name: Airtable - Get Record (Client)
modules.description: Get the client details for this episode

modules.name: Gmail - Send Email (Episode Delivery)
modules.description: Send episode delivery notification to client

config.subject: Your episode is ready: "{{1.Episode Title}}" - Episode #{{1.Episode Number}}

modules.name: Airtable - Update Record (Episode)
modules.description: Update episode status to indicate delivery email was sent

modules.name: Trello - Move Card
modules.description: Move episode card to 'Approved / Ready to Publish' list

modules.name: Airtable - Search Records (Clients)
modules.description: Find clients in 'Onboarding' status for 3+ days who haven't completed all steps

config.filterFormula: AND({Client Status} = 'Onboarding', {Onboarding Complete} = FALSE(), IS_BEFORE(DATEADD({Contract Start}, 3, 'days'), NOW()))

modules.name: Airtable - Search Records (Email Log)
modules.description: Check if reminder was already sent

modules.name: Filter
modules.description: Only proceed if no reminder has been sent yet

config.subject: Friendly reminder: a few onboarding items still need your attention

modules.name: Airtable - Search Records
modules.description: Find clients where Onboarding Complete checkbox was just checked

modules.name: Trello - Move Card
modules.description: Move onboarding card to 'Onboarding Complete' list

modules.name: Google Sheets - Update Row
modules.description: Update client status in revenue tracker

setup_instructions: 1. Create this scenario in Make.com, scheduled every 30 minutes
2. Connect all services: Airtable, Gmail, Trello, Google Sheets
3. This scenario handles three workflows via a router at the start
4. Route A: Episode delivery — watches Episodes table for 'Approved' status
5. Route B: Onboarding reminders — sends 1 reminder 3 days after onboarding starts
6. Route C: Onboarding completion — updates status when onboarding is marked complete
7. Replace placeholder URLs for questionnaire and onboarding calendar
8. Paste email HTML from gmail-templates/06 and 07
